a: App reads cache; on miss loads DB and populates cache.
Write-through writes cache and DB together.
Write-back writes cache first and flushes to DB later.
Read-through cache loads DB on miss on behalf of the app.
Add jitter to TTLs to avoid synchronized expirations.
Cache misses briefly to avoid repeated expensive lookups.
L1 local + L2 shared caches balance speed and coherence.
Invalidation is hard; prefer TTLs or event-driven deletes.
Hot keys need special handling like replication or local cache.
Thundering herd is many clients retrying a failed resource together.
